tools.p.a_modern_dslr_shot_in_raw_uncomp: A modern DSLR shot in RAW uncompressed can run 25–40 MB per image. Once you've converted and downsized for sharing, compressing is the fastest way to fit hundreds of photos into one email, one upload, or one cloud-storage folder. The visual difference is invisible at normal viewing sizes — usually a 70–80% file size reduction with no perceptible quality loss.
tools.p.add_captions_dates_quotes_names_: Add captions, dates, quotes, names, or save-the-date callouts. 14 fonts, full color and opacity control.
tools.p.after_prepping_photos_here_you_c: After prepping photos here, you can hand them to our AI Wedding Video Generator and we'll turn them into a cinematic film.
tools.p.ai_powered_wedding_video_service: AI-powered wedding video services for couples worldwide.
tools.p.anything_you_upload_via_our_orde: Anything you upload via our order form is encrypted in transit and at rest, deleted within 30 days of project completion (sooner on request), and never used for model training. Full details are in our privacy policy.
tools.p.drag_in_200_photos_set_high_comp: Drag in 200 photos, set "high compression", and download a zip in the time it takes to refill your coffee. We don't make you sign up.
tools.p.drop_2_12_photos_pick_a_layout_d: Drop 2–12 photos, pick a layout, drop in text — perfect for save-the-dates, thank-you cards, and gift prints.
tools.p.each_of_these_guides_pairs_with_: Each of these guides pairs with one or more of the tools above.
tools.p.each_tool_is_tuned_for_the_actua: Each tool is tuned for the actual formats couples deal with: iPhone HEIC, RAW exports, oversized prints, square vs vertical social needs.
tools.p.each_tool_opens_with_a_single_pa: Each tool opens with a single page — drop your photos, tweak the setting, download. Average task: under 30 seconds.
tools.p.files_are_processed_locally_noth: Files are processed locally. Nothing is uploaded.
tools.p.instantly_crop_to_9_16_reels_1_1: Instantly crop to 9:16 Reels, 1:1 Instagram square, 16:9 cinematic, or 4:5 portrait. Smart center-weighted framing.
tools.p.iphone_photos_in_heic_format_bre: iPhone photos in HEIC format break wedding albums, venues, and printers. Convert to JPG in one click.
tools.p.iphones_shoot_in_heic_by_default: iPhones shoot in HEIC by default. It's an excellent format for storage, but it confuses most album printers, online submission forms, and any software older than 2020. Convert HEIC to JPG before you do anything else. The tool keeps every bit of quality and renames the files for you.
tools.p.jpg_png_and_webp_across_all_tool: JPG, PNG, and WebP across all tools. HEIC is supported on the dedicated HEIC converter. GIF and BMP are converted via the standard image loaders but are not the focus.
tools.p.most_couple_portraits_come_with_: Most couple portraits come with a clean white, gray, or beige studio backdrop. The background remover cuts that backdrop out so you can drop the portrait over a vineyard, a sunset, or a custom wedding invitation design. Works best on traditional studio shots with even lighting.
tools.p.most_couples_walk_away_from_the_: Most couples walk away from the wedding with thousands of photos scattered across cameras, phones, hard drives, and group chats. By the time you want to make a film, a printed album, or a thank-you slideshow, the photos are usually in the wrong format, way too large to share, or trapped inside a single iPhone's HEIC encoding.
tools.p.most_of_our_paying_customers_han: Most of our paying customers hand us hundreds of photos as raw footage for an AI wedding film. We've watched those collections choke on file size, mismatched formats, and worst of all: missing engagement shots because nobody could find them in the upload. These tools solve the same frustrations we saw in our own pipeline — and we made them free because the wedding industry needed them too.
tools.p.no_every_tool_runs_entirely_in_y: No. Every tool runs entirely in your browser via the Canvas API. The photos never touch a server, are never analyzed, and never appear in any analytics event. You can verify this by opening the page, opening your browser's Network tab, and watching the only requests are for the HTML/CSS/JS files of the page itself.
tools.p.once_your_favorites_are_pre_crop: Once your favorites are pre-cropped and clean, the collage maker arranges 2–12 photos into gift prints, invitation inserts, parent albums, and thank-you cards. Pick a layout, type a caption, download as a print-ready PNG.
tools.p.once_your_photos_are_prepped_sen: Once your photos are prepped, send them to our AI Wedding Video Generator. Films, delivered in 48 hours.
tools.p.prepping_photos_is_step_one_step: Prepping photos is step one. Step two is turning your favorites into a cinematic wedding film. Our AI Wedding Video Generator takes a photo collection and a short description and produces a 60–90 second film in about 48 hours — no editing skills required. We've made films for over 500 couples across the US and Europe.
tools.p.save_the_dates_need_names_and_da: Save-the-dates need names and dates. Thank-you cards need thank-yous. Album spreads need dates and locations. Add text to a wedding photo with full font, color, and shadow control.
tools.p.shrink_huge_jpgs_by_60_85_before: Shrink huge JPGs by 60–85% before uploading to your album, sharing with family, or handing off to your videographer.
tools.p.six_pure_frontend_utilities_for_: Twelve pure-frontend utilities for prepping, sharing, and printing your wedding photos. We never see a single pixel - every byte stays on your device.
tools.p.strictly_in_browser_no_server_up: Strictly in-browser. No server uploads, no analytics tied to your photos, no scan-for-babies. Wedding photos are private — the tool respects that.
tools.p.strip_a_clean_studio_backdrop_wh: Strip a clean studio backdrop (white, black, gray) from a couple's portrait — ideal for invitations and announcements.
tools.p.this_page_collects_six_no_cost_t: This page collects six no-cost tools that solve each of those steps without uploading your personal photos to anyone. Run them in the order below, or jump straight to the one you need.
tools.p.want_to_see_what_one_looks_like_: Want to see what one looks like? Watch a few examples in our gallery or read the full guide to AI wedding videos from photos.
tools.p.wedding_photo_book_planner_pick_: Plan a printable wedding photo book in your browser. Pick 8x8, 10x10, 12x12, or A4. Drop in photos, distribute across 1/2/3/4-photo layouts, export 300 DPI PNG pages.
tools.p.wedding_seating_chart_maker_plan: Plan reception seating in your browser. Add guests, group by family or friends, drag and drop to round or long tables, auto-assign, and export a printable 1600x1200 PNG.
tools.p.yes_all_six_tools_work_on_ios_sa: Yes. All six tools work on iOS Safari and modern Android Chrome. The drop-zone responds to tap-to-pick from your camera roll. Output download is handled by the same browser save flow you use for any other file.
tools.p.yes_free_the_catch_if_you_can_ca: Yes, free. The catch — if you can call it that — is that after prepping your photos, we'd love it if you consider our paid AI Wedding Video Generator to turn those photos into a film. No email required to use the free tools, and no nudge to upgrade.
tools.p.your_photographer_delivered_3_2_: Your photographer delivered 3:2 landscape photos — gorgeous for prints, awkward for Instagram. Crop for Reels, square, or portrait with smart center-weighted framing so the bride's face stays on screen. Great for save-the-date reels, Instagram grid posts, and TikTok teasers.
